Today we make a renewed commitment to ensuring that the principle of equal treatment & justice under the law is a reality for all Americans, not just a select few. 

To truly honor MLK Jr., we must pass voting rights legislation now. The time to get this done is now. #MLKDay2022 https://t.co/DtN8O59xFb

A life-saving medication like PrEP, & its injectable version Apretude, should be available at no-cost to patients. To end the HIV/AIDS epidemic these drugs can not have a hefty price tag. @RepMondaire & I are leading our colleagues in this fight to make PrEP easily accessible. https://t.co/BKuyFnY2A5

NY hospitals continue to struggle w/ the economic burdens of the pandemic. Together w/ @SenSchumer & @RepJohnKatko, we’re leading the entire NY delegation in urging @fema to expedite the distribution of COVID-related financial assistance to hospitals across the state. https://t.co/bN3TJpvQwI
105 years after Puerto Ricans were granted American citizenship, they are still treated as second class citizens. Congress must grant #PRStatehood to ensure equal treatment under the law.

Today is National Women & Girls HIV/AIDS Awareness Day. We remember those we lost & the impact this epidemic has on women, especially Black women. We recommit ourselves to the fight for accessible treatment & ending HIV/AIDS around the globe. https://t.co/v4MM8E9RWz

A budget that leaves 45,000 undocumented New Yorkers without access to healthcare coverage does not reflect the values of our state or who we are. We need #Coverage4All in the NYS budget.
https://t.co/wfbE2lPuWX

Black patients lose limbs at a rate triple that of others. This #PADAwarnessMonth, let’s work to optimize health literacy and educate at-risk communities about #PAD and the need for #PADscreenings. #CBCxPAD https://t.co/hDFzuwc3px

The cost of prescription drugs has become unbearable for many. That’s why the #InflationReductionAct is so important. It caps insulin for Medicare patients at $35 a month, caps out-of-pocket prescription drug costs for seniors at $2,000 a year, and lets Medicare negotiate prices.

During a national mental health crisis, paperwork shouldn't stand in the way of timely care.

#PriorAuth too often limits providers from connecting patients w/ needed services—it's time to pass the Improving Seniors’ Timely Access to Care Act. https://t.co/HH9Ct37H7U

Today is National Gay Men’s HIV/AIDS Awareness Day. We must work to end the stigma, ensure equitable access to preventative medicines like PrEP, and improve access to testing and treatment. #NGMHAAD https://t.co/mePFAlUbet https://t.co/DGsvNbnk4A

It’s time to #GetCovered with reliable, affordable health insurance through the #ACA marketplaces.

Starting November 1st, you can visit https://t.co/1EDRY2lF1Z to enroll in health coverage for 2023.

Families can now enroll in affordable #ACA coverage for 2023 on https://t.co/AcCOWSqHWG.

Need help going through the process? Free help is available at the https://t.co/AcCOWSqHWG Call Center, 1-800-318-2596.

🚨Today is the last day to enroll for coverage for 2023. Make sure that your friends and family have coverage. 
For more information and to sign up, go to https://t.co/AcCOWS9758 or call 1-800-318-2596.
Let us recommit ourselves to ending the stigma and shame surrounding HIV/AIDS and continue working to increase prevention, testing, treatment, and education. #NWGHAAD

September is #SuicidePreventionAwarenessMonth, a time to remember those affected by suicide and recommit to expanding access to mental health treatment for those who need it most.

If you or a loved one is in crisis, call or text 988 for free confidential help 24/7. https://t.co/7X7wkhuksk

Make no mistake -- there will be real life consequences for an extreme House Republican government shutdown.

Nearly seven million vulnerable women, children, and infants will be at risk of losing WIC nutrition assistance, including more than 418,000 in New York alone.

I’m proud to have secured $3 million dollars for Lincoln Hospital to replace 200 beds with new, state of the art medical beds. This new technology will improve the treatment of patients, and the experience of our essential healthcare workers working to keep the Bronx healthy. https://t.co/NGVKgafm6s

The South Bronx has been hit hard by the opioid epidemic. I'm proud to have secured $825,000 for Acacia Network's PROMESA RRSY- a comprehensive and culturally-responsive addiction treatment program for young men 14-20, including justice-involved youth. https://t.co/Mf4ADrLFGU

City officials are still advising anyone in the nearby area to exercise caution. NYC Emergency Management has opened a reception center for anyone affected by the recent partial building collapse located at PS 396, 1930 Andrews Ave. in the Bronx.
🚨My bipartisan legislation with @michaelcburgess to improve mental health and drug treatment just overwhelmingly passed the House in a package by a vote of 386-37. https://t.co/YIA2srip2i

Every Bronxite should have access to swimming in the summer to cool off and get good exercise.

NY SWIMS is going to help do just that.
This Juneteenth, let us come together to celebrate freedom, and recommit to the fight for civil rights and equal treatment under the law for Black Americans. https://t.co/IAV3APYOnc

There is no question — gender affirming care saves lives.

Every family must have the right to pursue treatment for their children that their trusted physician deems beneficial.

It is unacceptable and unAmerican for the state to intervene and prevent it. https://t.co/VkdrQNQ57z

I had a productive meeting today with the Puerto Rican Secretary of the Family Cieni Rodriguez and the Executive Director of @PRFAA Luis Davila Pernas.

We discussed the importance of passing the Puerto Rico Nutrition Assistance Fairness Act, which will extend SNAP to Puerto Rico.

When it comes to public safety and mental health, the system is broken. Fixing it will require action across every level of government.

End the IMD exclusion, which restricts federal funding for inpatient care. Empower the Mayor to involuntarily remove dangerous people from the streets and subways. Prohibit the early release of dangerous criminals like Ramon Rivera, who stabbed to death three innocent New Yorkers.
